claims.subject: relationship--thrip--verified-boundary--d536972f16c9943b
claims.statement: Thrip overlaps-with Lotus Blossom: MITRE ATT&CK 19.2 tracks Lotus Blossom (G0030) and Thrip (G0076) as separate Groups even though Thrip remains an associated name in the Lotus Blossom record; the shared name is therefore an overlap signal, not a safe exact alias.
claims.verification_rationale: Primary-source-verified taxonomy boundary; this relationship must not be converted into an exact alias.
